lessons.claim: Rule 10 (2026-09-02, user instruction): lay out every number a run will use, with value + unit + provenance, and get human approval before starting. Implemented as bdbot/params.py Manifest, blocking runcard.RunCard sealability and run.execute(require_approval=True). Three properties make it a gate not a habit: a bare float is rejected (unit='1' declares dimensionless, blank means forgotten); 'if applicable' means not_applicable(category, reason) which raises on an empty reason; an unknown number blocks via unknown(name, needed_from) rather than being invented. And diff_against_spec catches approving one set of numbers then running another. Written as a gate because this repo is three-for-three against practices-without-gates: bd-intake 2.1's empty-goal blocker (written twice, enforced zero times, 2 of 8 cases walked past it and produced 85 runs), A4's grep (7 false hits), health.gate() (reachable only from tools/health.py:138, absent from run.py).
